title: 1600 East Rich Street (House), Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: The single family residence is a contributing structure to the Near East Side Historic District, a predominately residential area which developed between 1880 and 1930 and which contains those styles favored by the upper middle class of that period.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 78002063
